🔐 Firestore Security Rules

          

            If manager/VP sees blank dashboard, your Firestore rules are blocking reads.

            Go to Firebase Console → Firestore Database → Rules and paste the rules below, then click Publish.
          

          
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {
    match /{document=**} {
      allow read, write: if request.auth != null;
    }
  }
}

          

            
            
              🌐 Open Firebase Console →
            
            opens in new tab
          

        


        
        

          
🔥 Realtime Database Rules

          

            If manager/VP still sees blank dashboard after Firestore rules are set, RTDB rules are also blocking reads.

            Go to Firebase Console → Realtime Database → Rules and paste the rules below, then click Publish.
          

          
{
  "rules": {
    "davan_pub": {
      ".read": true,
      ".write": "auth != null"
    },
    ".read": "auth != null",
    ".write": "auth != null"
  }
}

          

            
            
              🌐 Open Firebase Console →
            
            opens in new tab

⏰ Background Scheduler Setup (One-Time)

          

            After deploying the updated worker code, do these steps once in Cloudflare to make all push notifications fire automatically — even when no browser is open.
          

          

            

              
Step 1 — Deploy updated worker code

              
Click Show Cloudflare Worker Code above → Copy → paste into your worker at dash.cloudflare.com → Save & Deploy. The new code has both the push delivery (unchanged) and the background scheduler.

            

            

              
Step 2 — Add Cron Trigger

              
In your worker dashboard → Settings → Triggers → Cron Triggers → Add Cron

              Enter exactly: * * * * * (every minute) → Save.

            

            

              
Step 3 — Add Environment Variables

              
In your worker → Settings → Variables → Add variable (two of them):

              FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID = davan-attendance-2026

              FIREBASE_API_KEY = AIzaSyBUuOH-GLPHhcz9a3fIT5ewVcyaZyCguto

            

            

              
✅ After setup — what works automatically:

              

                • Day-before faculty alerts fire at your configured time (e.g. 8:00 PM)

                • Pre-class alerts fire X minutes before each class

                • Tomorrow's calendar event notification fires at your configured time

                • Dedup via Firestore — no duplicate alerts even across restarts

                • Works 24/7, no browser, no PC needs to be on
